podcast.body: Featured on the "Judgment Night" soundtrack, this song was used by Ash Boo Shultz of USS in an experimental stage performance. He would play it on a cassette tape simultaneously with a "how to heal your inner child" tape to create discomfort and explore neuroplasticity. "And then on this one, I'd have like you're just another victim by helmet and house of pain from the judgmentite soundtrack."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: USS In Their Own Words: Part 2

podcast.body: Helmet collaborated with House of Pain on the song "Just Another Victim" for the 1993 *Judgment Night* soundtrack. This "ground breaking" collaboration was part of a radical experiment to pair rock and hip-hop acts, serving as a major catalyst for the rap rock and nu metal genres that became very big later in the decade. "It's Helmut and House of Pain with just another victim."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
